title: Hilbert-Schmidt norm of the block operator [[0, H^T],[H, 0]]
statement: For natural numbers n, l, a continuous linear H : R^n -> R^l and a continuous linear D : R^(n+l) -> R^(n+l) such that D(graphPoint x y) = graphPoint (sum_{i<n} <H e_i, y> e_i) (H x) for all x in R^n, y in R^l (e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 in R^n): hsNormSq D = 2 hsNormSq H, where hsNormSq B = sum_k ||B E_k||^2 over the standard basis.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (H : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) (D : Amb n ℓ →L[ℝ] Amb n ℓ), (∀ (x : Rn n) (y : Rn ℓ), D (graphPoint x y) = graphPoint (∑ i : Fin n, inner ℝ (H (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) y • EuclideanSpace.single i 1) (H x)) → hsNormSq D = 2 * hsNormSq H
